stagingProbeOrder.humanAcceptance: In a disposable nonproduction Supabase project, verify Auth provider session provenance and accessible read-only session metadata after actual JWT validation; never assume auth.sessions schema or permissions.
Validate owner, staff, worker and shop binding using independently authorized test accounts and server-only adapters; reject wrong-shop, revoked and client-supplied roles.
Verify a new real provider session after acknowledged commit and reject all prior sessions after cutover; confirm timestamp ordering and old-token invalidation.
Use only an approved isolated LINE test channel to inspect timeout and uncertain-send responses, record provider acknowledgement details, and never infer delivery.
With an independently administered external test storage account, show append-only retention, independent verification and recovery without application DB admin control.
Demonstrate off-application signing key custody, key rotation and revocation with pinned public keys and a separately stored monotonic witness cursor.
Execute supervised staging-only user and job flows through a verified provider session, role checks, atomic outbox and manual ambiguity review, with no customer traffic.

sourceFinding: R46 /auth/v1/user validation returns {verified:true,sub:user.id,exp:claims.exp} without independently verified provider session identifier. Authentication can be valid as a user but is insufficient as proof of a live provider session for atomic business writes.
nextOperatorAction: No user action until explicit isolated Supabase project and authorization boundaries are prepared; never paste service-role credentials in GitHub or chat.
